Omar (go-sdk): Quick note: our Go generator stream API currently returns a wrapped transport error when ctx is cancelled. This makes it hard for callers to switch on context.Canceled.
Fiona (devex): yeah that's painful in examples. folks expect ctx.Err() style checks. Can you show the minimal behavior?
Omar (go-sdk): example: 
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
stream, _ := client.Generator("gpt-foo").GenerateStream(ctx, req)
cancel()
_, err := stream.Next() // err is something like "read tcp ...: i/o timeout"
if errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) { /* won't match */ }
```
Omar (go-sdk): proposal: normalize cancellation to return context.Canceled (or a sentinel SDK error that wraps it) so users can reliably detect cancellation.
Tess (runtime): on runtime side we sometimes send EOF and let transport close. Network errors get bubbled up. Normalizing sounds fine but we should document that transport errors are still possible for network failures.
Fiona (devex): docs + examples must show the recommended pattern: check context.Err() before interpreting err from Next/Events loop; but normalization still makes copy/paste friendly.
Omar (go-sdk): implemented small change: if ctx.Err() != nil at time of returning, return context.Canceled. Added unit test. Opened PR: https://git.redwood/patch/456
Tess (runtime): can you also add a test that simulates server-side EOF vs client cancel so we don't conflate them?
Omar (go-sdk): yup added both tests. One ensures net.ErrClosed still surfaces as net error, the other ensures ctx cancel is normalized.
BuildBot: CI passed on branch go/stream-cancel-normalize :white_check_mark:
Fiona (devex): nice. please add a short blurb in quickstart about "cancellation best practices" and update the sample app to use defer stream.Close() + check ctx.Err().
Omar (go-sdk): will do. also thinking to add GenerateStreamWithCancel(ctx) variant that returns (stream, cancelFunc). Thoughts?
Tess (runtime): that API is ergonomic but duplicates context semantics. if we do it, document tradeoffs.
Fiona (devex): agree. For now land the normalization + docs, then iterate on helper API if needed.
Omar (go-sdk): thanks
